title: Deadline and Ghost Again
author: Sable Whitlock
blurb: August Winterbourne, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
